SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, u.sex, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.del_flag = 0
AND u.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
AND (u.dept_id = #{query.deptId} OR u.dept_id IN ( SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{query.deptId}, ancestors) AND del_flag = 0 ))
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.username}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, u.sex, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = 0

SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, u.sex, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.del_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 0 AND m.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT post_id FROM sys_user_post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
